text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a modest gain felt good, but I should focus on whether selling fits my long-term plan rather than chasing that feeling.","I went several months without trading while my account fell substantially; even though I check infrequently, I should periodically review my holdings and whether my reasons for owning them still hold.","Selling Stocks B, D, and E after steep losses was painful; I should assess each position calmly and avoid both clinging to losses and selling simply to escape discomfort."]}
